feedback: Can't log in after the update. Tried resetting password 3 times — still locked out.
Love the new dashboard! Seeing all my accounts in one place is a game changer.
Biometric login works maybe 50% of the time. Very annoying for a banking app.
Transferred money to wrong account. The confirmation screen needs to show full account number, not just last 4 digits.
App crashes every single time I try to open my credit card statement.
The new spending insights feature is brilliant. Helped me realize I was spending $400/month on subscriptions.
International wire transfer has been 'processing' for 6 days. No update, no ETA.
Notifications for transactions stopped working after iOS 18 update.
Why does the app log me out every 5 minutes? Extremely frustrating.
Depositing a cheque by photo has never worked for me. Image always fails quality check.
Customer support chat is incredible — agent resolved my dispute in under 10 minutes.
Two-factor authentication code takes over 3 minutes to arrive via SMS. By then it's expired.
My salary was credited but the app shows wrong available balance. Very worrying.
Scheduled payments are going out a day early and causing overdraft fees. This is a serious bug.
The dark mode is gorgeous. Best banking UI I've used.
Fraud alert system blocked my card while I was travelling even after I set travel notification.
Interest calculator tool in the savings section is really helpful for planning.
App refuses to load on any WiFi network. Works fine on mobile data. Something is wrong with your servers.
Statement download fails every time. Just gives a blank PDF.
Please add UPI integration. All other banking apps have it.
The budget tracker categorizes my grocery spend as 'Entertainment'. The AI needs work.
Loan EMI calculator gave me completely wrong numbers. I almost signed for the wrong amount!
Virtual card feature for online shopping is excellent. Feels very secure.
App size is 400MB. That's absurd for a banking app. Please optimize.
My fixed deposit matured 2 weeks ago and still hasn't auto-renewed as per my settings.
Transaction search is too slow. Searching 6 months of history takes 15 seconds.
The investment portfolio section crashes when I have more than 10 mutual funds linked.
Loved the financial health score feature. Very motivating to improve it.
Can't add joint account holder through the app. Forced to visit the branch for something so basic.
Bill payment history disappeared after the last update. Called support, no one knows where it went.
The new card controls (freeze/unfreeze) are exactly what I needed. Used it right away.
Recurring transfer failed silently. No notification, no error. Just didn't execute.
Font size in the transaction list is way too small. Impossible to read without zooming.
Why is there no option to export transactions as CSV? Only PDF is available.
App is super smooth and fast on my new phone. Major improvement from last year.
Account opening was 100% digital and took 7 minutes. Absolutely phenomenal experience.
Video KYC call dropped 4 times. Had to restart the whole verification process.
The app shows my account as 'inactive' even though I transact regularly. Called support — no resolution.
Loved getting a real-time credit score update right in the app. No third-party needed.
Linked my other bank accounts for net worth view — feature is great but syncing fails every other day.
Chatbot is completely useless. Just redirects to FAQs for every question, even urgent ones.
Tax summary report for the financial year is a lifesaver. Sent it straight to my CA.
Zero customer service — been waiting 8 days for a response on a disputed charge.
App blocked my international payment with no explanation. Had to use a competitor's card.
Love the round-up savings feature. Saved ₹3,000 without even noticing.
Please add the ability to set custom transaction categories. The default ones are too generic.
The app randomly signs me out and when I sign back in, my widgets are reset.
Getting duplicate transaction notifications. Same transaction shows up 3-4 times.
Passbook download doesn't include UPI transactions. Huge gap.
Best banking app I've used. Switching to competitor feels unthinkable now.
